subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw backfill signed macOS desktop assets and a beta Sparkle appcast for `v2026.5.22-beta.1`, or leave that old prerelease without desktop distribution and handle future beta policy separately?
rationale: The source tree cannot prove or perform the private signing/notary/upload path, and current docs make beta macOS distribution optional rather than mandatory.

options.title: Do not backfill old beta
options.body: Record that `v2026.5.22-beta.1` intentionally remains without macOS desktop assets and use the paired PR or successor only for future beta distribution policy.

options.title: Backfill signed beta assets
options.body: Run the private macOS release-ops publish path for this tag and commit a valid separate beta appcast to public main after verifying Sparkle and GitHub assets.

options.title: Keep as policy tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower release-policy PR resolves the beta desktop distribution contract.

recommendation.title: Do not backfill old beta
recommendation.body: Record that `v2026.5.22-beta.1` intentionally remains without macOS desktop assets and use the paired PR or successor only for future beta distribution policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about release policy and appcast publication, and this history has the strongest appcast/release ownership signal.
